destination.description:
Where the source goes: `"forge"` (default, `<forge>/.trash/`),
`"system"` (OS trash), or `"permanent"`.

source.description: Forge-relative path of the note that is absorbed and then deleted.

target.description: Forge-relative path of the note that receives the source body.

update_links.description: Rewrite inbound links on `source` to point at `target`. Default `true`.
